 2026 FCS Picks: Week 8
 NCAA FCS Previews 
 22 October 2026 By Dunkel Index 
 The NC Central Eagles and Delaware State Hornets kick off Week 8 of the FCS schedule on Friday as they meet in a MEAC matchup at Alumni Stadium. This is the conference opener for both teams. Under second-year head coach DeSean Jackson, the Hornets (4-3) enter conference play with a winning record and a perfect 4-0 home record this season. The Eagles (2-5) are looking to snap a four-game losing streak. NCCU has struggled defensively during this stretch, giving up 38 or more points in three of those four defeats. 
 NC CENTRAL AT DELAWARE STATE ODDS, GAME TIME
 Game Date:  Friday, October 23, 2026
 Game Time:  7:00 PM ET
 Location:  Dover, DE
 Stadium:  Alumni Stadium
 Favorite:  Delaware State Hornets
 Underdog:  NC Central Eagles
 Over/under:  55.5
